title: How Many Are Not Above
statement:
A sorted list of `n` numbers is given, followed by `q` questions. For each question value `x`, find how many numbers in the list are less than or equal to `x`. Print the total of the answers to all questions.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `q`. The second line contains `n` integers in non-decreasing order. The third line contains the `q` question values.

## Output
Print the sum of the answers to all questions. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, q <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i, x_j <= 10^9`
